senses.definition: vb. swallow, swallow down (Syriac ܠܰܥ, ܠܳܥ lap or lick up Ju 7:5–7);—
Pf. 3 pl. וְלָע֫וּ consec. Ob 16 (Ges§ 67 R. 12);—abs., fig. of nations drinking (cup of judgment).—Hi De talk wildly, vid. II. לוע; We Now נָעוּ reel, totter (cf. Is 24:20; 29:9).
